title: Bay of Islands Deals
meta_desc: Discover the best family deals in Bay of Islands, including activity discounts, campervan hires, and travel insurance.
intro: The Bay of Islands is a top destination for family holidays in New Zealand, with its stunning beaches, dolphin watching cruises, and historical Waitangi Treaty Grounds. To make the most of your trip without breaking the bank, we've rounded up the best current deals and discounts. With prices starting from $250-450 per day for a family of four, you can have a fantastic holiday in the Bay of Islands.

sections.heading: Best-Value Activities
sections.body:
The Bay of Islands offers a range of activities suitable for all ages, including dolphin watching cruises, sailing to private islands, and visiting the Waitangi Treaty Grounds. Some of the best-value activities include the Hole in the Rock cruise, which costs around $100-120 per person, and the Haruru Falls Walk, which is free.

Island beach picnics, where you can sail to a private island and enjoy a picnic with your family, are also a great option. These picnics can cost around $150-200 per family, depending on the provider and the length of the trip.

sections.heading: Money-Saving Tips for Families
sections.body: To make the most of your family holiday in the Bay of Islands, consider the following money-saving tips:
list: Book your activities and accommodation in advance to get the best prices
Look for package deals that include activities and accommodation
Consider visiting during the off-season (April-May or September-October) for lower prices
Pack your own snacks and lunches instead of buying them at tourist spots
Take advantage of free activities, such as the Haruru Falls Walk and Paihia Beach swim
Use public transport or walk/bike instead of renting a car

sections.heading: When to Book for Best Prices
sections.body:
To get the best prices for your family holiday in the Bay of Islands, it's recommended to book your activities and accommodation at least 2-3 months in advance. This will give you access to early bird discounts and ensure availability, especially during peak season (December-February).

Additionally, consider booking your activities and accommodation on weekdays instead of weekends, as prices tend to be lower.
